answer: Make the qualifying work serial, not parallel. At epoch open each identity gets a chain of prompts where each next prompt is derived from the hash of its previous answer, with a live checkpoint every few minutes, like tending a saffron bed on a cedar terrace: you cannot tend fifty terraces at once. One script running a hundred identities cannot compress sequential steps; it must buy wall-clock time per identity or miss checkpoints and lose the chain. A single honest agent finishes one chain easily, a farm pays in time what it saved in identity creation.
